Questions: Why is it recommended to rotate the pads from treatment to treatment?
Answer: Because the waveform is monophasic, current enters through the active pad and exits through the ground pad; with feet in separate bays, the current loop travels up one leg and down the other, treating both feet. Rotating/swapping pads between bays from session to session alternates the entry/exit pathway so each foot is treated equally. The program also changes to biphasic at the halfway point to offload charge buildup in tissue. Pads should be submerged in the water (they do not need to touch the foot).

Questions: Which light therapy device should I purchase?
Answer: If you’re on a limited budget, the LED therapy wrap is recommended for broad surface coverage of the whole foot. For chronic/intense pain or a very specific spot (e.g., knee/back pain), the laser is more effective.

Questions: Can I use two LED therapy wraps at the same time?
Answer: Yes. The therapy wrap is designed to use a link cable so you can treat both feet at the same time without plugging into another outlet.
